blind.description: A freestanding heraldic banner display. It features a square bevelled grey stone base holding a vertical wooden post, which is topped by a polished golden spherical finial. A horizontal wooden crossbar extends through the post with squared end caps, over which drapes a stylized fabric banner with a green and yellow checkerboard pattern and yellow fringed trim along the bottom edge. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly modeled in a stylized hand-painted fantasy asset style.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a horizontal crossbar with exposed wooden ends and a central gold sphere, draped with yellow and green cloth on both sides, with the edges of the square stone plinth visible beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 5 ft 9 in to 6 ft tall to the top of the finial), and about two-thirds as wide as it is tall (around 3.5 to 4 ft wide across the crossbar).

notes: crossbar is wider than requested catalog ratio, but height is accurate at 9.2 ft
